title: Concept: Git dependency that follows a tag name
description: package.json declares a git dependency fragment that names a tag rather than a commit, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A tag can be force-moved by whoever controls the remote, so the installed tree is mutable even though the manifest looks pinned.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: A tag can be force-moved by whoever controls the remote, so the installed tree is mutable even though the manifest looks pinned.
